o.text: From Proto-Turkic *üskür-. Cognate with Turkish öksürmek, Chuvash ӳсӗр (üs̬ĕr), etc. By surface analysis, ös (“coughing sound”) + -kür.
Borrowed from Arabic تَارِيخِيّ (tārīḵiyy). By surface analysis, tarix + -i.
From iki (“two”) + məna (“sense, meaning”) + -lı. Calque of Russian двусмы́сленный (dvusmýslennyj).
